patch_description: Replace the fixed 5-tap binomial post-smoothing with a locally adaptive "snap" stage. The key weakness (lag_error 0.33, slope_changes 108) comes from globally applying a smoothing kernel: clean dynamic segments get over-smoothed (lag) while noisy segments may still jitter. Instead: (1) compute robust local noise scale σ via sliding_window_view on the diff of the pre-filtered signal (fully vectorized, efficiency stays ~1.00); (2) where consecutive output differences are below the local threshold (0.5·σ), snap them toward the local median slope (aggressive de-jitter in noisy segments); (3) where diffs exceed the threshold (genuine dynamics), leave them untouched (no added lag). This preserves responsiveness (0.75 has margin) while cutting spurious slope changes and false reversals.
